title: After Getting Burned by Gray Investing
description:
Two months since you got burned by the gray-market investment.
Thinking back still stung.
Today a similar offer came in.

choices.result_text:
You declined right away.
Getting burned once had sharpened the response.
Experience exists for exactly this moment.

You listened.
The structure was the same as before.
Listening itself — was a signal you could get pulled in again.

title: After Investigating the Shadow
description:
Two months since you dug into the gray-market structure yourself.
It hadn't been easy.
Today it collapsed — and the news broke.

choices.result_text:
You'd seen it coming.
Because you'd looked into it, you'd seen it.
Knowing something — sometimes lets you get out of the way.

It felt bitter.
You thought about the people who got hurt.
You had the information and escaped — they didn't.

title: After Confronting the Guarantee Problem
description:
Two months since you faced the loan guarantee issue head-on.
That conversation had not been easy.
Today the outcome came in.

choices.result_text:
Confronting it directly had created movement.
Left alone, it would have dragged on — facing it brought it to an end.
An uncomfortable conversation prevents a longer discomfort.

Not fully resolved yet.
But different from before the confrontation.
A start is what makes an ending possible.

title: After Taking the Legal Route
description:
Three months since you chose the legal route on the guarantee issue.
It had been a slow fight.
Today there was an update on how it was going.

choices.result_text:
You kept going.
Legal routes are slow.
But they leave a record — that's what sets them apart from other options.

You were getting worn out.
You hadn't expected it to take this long.
But stopping meant everything so far evaporated.
The other side is waiting for you to quit — which is exactly why you can't.

title: As the Freelance Work Grows
description:
Three months into freelancing.
It had been uneven at first.
Today a steady client came through.

choices.result_text:
You kept going.
One reliable client — becomes the most important foundation.
The freelancer's fear is no work. Right now, that's not the problem.

You thought about full-time.
Once stability arrived — bigger stability pulled at you.
That's just human. But this path is also its own kind of stability.

title: After Starting to Post Content
description:
Two months since you started posting on social media.
Almost no response.
Today — for the first time, a stranger left a comment.

choices.result_text:
You decided to keep going.
One person — is a start.
Only those who survive the quiet period get to see the noisy one.

You thought about changing direction.
You used that comment as a hint.
One person's reaction — can be a compass for where to go next.

title: After Deciding to Go It Alone
description:
Two months since you decided to keep the startup going solo.
It had been lonely without a team.
Today, for the first time, someone offered to help.

choices.result_text:
You tried it together.
A collaborator found while going alone — was possible because you'd held on alone.
What started solo had become shared.

You watched first.
Someone appearing right away — was too soon to trust.
Having done it alone — meant you could now see whether this person was needed.

title: After Going After the Landlord
description:
Two months since you tracked down the landlord over the jeonse issue.
Contact had gone dark after that.
Today documents arrived from the court.

choices.result_text:
You followed the steps.
Going there in person had created a record.
That record was now the foundation for this process.

You were worn out.
But stopping meant losing everything.
The landlord is waiting for you to exhaust yourself — that's exactly why you have to hold on.

title: After Reconnecting with Daeun
description:
Two months since you reconnected with Daeun after a long distance.
At first it had been awkward.
Today she suggested meeting first.

choices.result_text:
You met.
Reconnecting — was because both of you had wanted it.
Mending a relationship that had frayed — is more serious than starting one.

choices.text: Ask what kind of meeting it is first
choices.result_text:
You asked what kind of meeting.
She said 'Just.'
Just — holds more than it sounds.

title: After Helping a Friend Who Failed
description:
Two months since you helped a friend whose business had failed.
You'd been thinking about how they were doing.
Today they reached out.

choices.result_text:
You said 'How are things?'
They said 'Slowly starting to rebuild.'
Checking in after helping — shows what real help looks like.

You reached out first.
They said 'Thanks. I got through it because of you.'
Help isn't just the moment. The memory of it keeps people going.

title: After Turning Envy into Fuel
description:
Three months since you decided to use the envy as energy.
The comparisons had been painful at first.
Today you found a place where you'd moved ahead.

choices.result_text:
You had.
When you'd decided to use envy as fuel — this was the destination.
Comparison becomes a tool when you set the right target.

choices.text: Still a long way to go
choices.result_text:
Still a long way.
But having a direction — was different from three months ago.
Envy had become energy — this change was proof.

title: After Drawing the Line
description:
Two months since you held a line at a work dinner for the first time.
Some awkwardness had stayed.
Today the same situation came around again.

choices.result_text:
You held the line again.
Once is harder than twice — twice starts to feel natural.
A boundary isn't drawn once — it's drawn over and over.

This time you gave in.
Having a boundary doesn't mean being inflexible.
Reading the situation and choosing — that's someone who actually has one.

title: After the Holiday Reconciliation
description:
Two months since you reconciled with estranged family at a holiday gathering.
The awkwardness of that day still sat in memory.
Today a message came from them.

choices.result_text:
You answered warmly.
The holiday reconciliation had made this message possible.
Reconciliation doesn't end on the day. The messages that follow are what complete it.

choices.text: Not fully comfortable yet, but you answer
choices.result_text:
Not fully at ease yet — but you answered.
Comfort takes time.
Answering at all — is proof the reconciliation is still continuing.

title: After Declaring the Dream
description:
Three months since you declared Gangnam as your goal.
Sometimes saying it out loud had made it feel heavier.
Today you ran into someone who'd heard it.

choices.result_text:
You said 'Things are moving.'
They said 'I remembered that.'
A declaration isn't just for yourself — it becomes a standard for those who heard it too.

choices.text: Honestly say you've still got a long way
choices.result_text:
You said honestly 'Still a long way to go.'
They said 'But you're still going.'
Keeping a declaration — isn't about the result. It's about keeping the direction.

title: After Deleting Social Media
description:
Two months since you deleted social media because the comparisons were hurting.
The first days had felt empty.
Today you looked back on the time since.

choices.result_text:
Your focus had shifted.
No feed meant time had opened up.
How that time was actually used — that's what the deletion was worth.

choices.text: Sometimes think about putting it back
choices.result_text:
Sometimes you thought about putting it back.
But you remembered why you'd deleted it.
As long as the reason still held — the decision did too.
